children: Wipro Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:WIPRO) posted largely flat Q2FY27 revenue and mixed IT‑services guidance while winning top ISG FAO rankings, even as U.S. visa probes and a PERM suspension—plus a trading window closure—spurred a share drop and raised hiring/delivery risks.
Previous Week Recap
WIPRO Revenue Outlook Range
: WIPRO Q2FY27 revenue seen ₹24,885–24,924 cr (q/q +1.7–1.8%, y/y +9.6–9.8%); constant‑currency revenue likely down 0.5–1.0% q/q. IT services outlook $2.574–2.627 bn (cc q/q -1.5% to +0.5%).
Wipro ADR PERM Suspended

: U.S. Dept. of Labor suspended new and pending PERM applications for Wipro ADR (WIPRO) on Oct 8, 2026, halting new employer-sponsored green card filings; existing H‑1B and approved I‑140 remain valid.
Wipro ADR Alleged Visa Misuse
: U.S. government alleges visa misuse by Wipro Limited Sponsored ADR (WIPRO) as part of a wider probe into major IT service firms, naming WIPRO among companies cited in the complaint.
Wipro ADR Revenue Flatish Outlook
: Wipro ADR (WIPRO) revenue seen roughly flat: Systematix forecasts ~-0.6% CC QoQ with inorganic help from Mindsprint/Alphanet; JM Financial expects ~-0.5% CC QoQ with ~80bp inorganic boost.
Wipro ADR Stock Slump On Suspension
: Wipro ADR (WIPRO) fell about 3% intraday after the company announced a suspension; traders saw the price drop tied to that announcement.
Immigration Rules Push Offshore Hiring
: Changes in U.S. immigration enforcement may cut green-card-backed U.S. roles for WIPRO, pushing the firm toward more temporary visas, local U.S. hires, or increased offshore delivery.
MEA Criticizes U.S. PERM Pause
: India's MEA criticized the U.S. for pausing PERM approvals affecting Wipro (WIPRO), saying limits on Indian IT worker mobility hurt both countries and named Wipro among impacted firms.
Wipro Trading Window Closed
: Wipro ADR (WIPRO) trading window closed for designated persons from Sept 16, 2026 through Oct 17, 2026; affected insiders prohibited from trading during this one-month period.
Wipro Named Leader In ISG FAO
: Wipro Limited Sponsored ADR (WIPRO) was named a Leader in all four ISG 2026 FAO quadrants—Invoice to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report and FP&A, alongside other major providers.
